key_idea: The middle pirate has the same number of pirates before him and after him.
steps: The captain is the 7th pirate, so 6 pirates climb before him.
He is exactly in the middle, so 6 pirates climb after him too.

choice_feedback.A: With 12 pirates, nobody is exactly in the middle.
choice_feedback.B: With 14 pirates, nobody is exactly in the middle.
choice_feedback.C: 7 counts only the pirates up to the captain. 6 more come after him.
choice_feedback.E: 15 would put 8 pirates after the captain, but only 6 come before him.
